facts.fact: E2e test memory-ingest.spec.ts covers agent's ingest job in memory imports view; backend counterpart: memoryflow TestMcpIngestExternal.
Ingest test builds data from recorded contracts 'MemoryImportService.Jobs#mcp' and 'MemoryImportService.Job#mcp' of 'memory-import' contract, job state overridden to 'running'.
Group ids generated per run, masked in contract, so test gives each file synthetic groupId of form kg_flowgroup0<index>.
For agent (mcp) ingest job, imports view shows channel 'Agent', origin 'External · slack', scope 'Company'.
Imports view lists each ingested file with kind label (json shown as 'JSON', markdown as 'Markdown') and added count as '+N'; expanding file row shows its group id.
Recorded agent ingest job contract expected to contain exactly two files.
